findings: D1 (universe/smallness): ZFSK smallness is not tracked; Lean universe levels are a rough analogue. Bounded: none of the pilot-cluster statements depend on U-large objects.

D2 (carrier model): fixed ambient U rather than arbitrary small carriers; componentwise operations coincide on subobjects but cross-family unions of unrelated carriers are not directly expressible. Residual caveat; must be propagated into dependent trust boundaries.

D4 (Setoid vs relation): the paper's order Phi subseteq Psi is inclusion of relations; Lean uses setoid refinement. This is a bridge obligation (setoid_le_iff) that is NOT yet proved, so the record is not 'faithful' yet.
D3/D5 bounded: the pilot cluster uses no absolute complement and no quotient construction, so those divergences do not affect it.
D6: classical logic uses only the permitted axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound). D7: empty sorts/components are permitted.
Verdict: faithful-with-caveat with residuals D1, D2, D4.
independence_caveat: Same-session self-audit by the same agent that drafted the record; NOT independent (Architecture.md Sections 9, 11.5). An independent encoding auditor must re-run this before the representation is treated as accepted.
